title: Introduce adaptive faithfulness linter and blackbox reprobe CI hook
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Add an adaptive faithfulness linter CI hook that flags prompt-set regressions using a calibrated faithfulness score; includes a blackbox reprobe job for flaky prompts and a backfill utility.
description: Motivation: We frequently see subtle regressions in instruction-following tests where token-level metrics (BLEU/ROUGE) miss factual corruption or instruction deviation. This PR introduces an adaptive faithfulness linter that runs as a CI hook and a complementary blackbox reprobe runner to triage flaky prompts. The linter computes a compact faithfulness_score per prompt (0.0-1.0) by combining oracle-agreement heuristics, normalized edit-distance to expected canonicalizations, and a lightweight entailment check. It supports progressive soft-fail thresholds (warning -> soft-fail -> hard-fail) so maintainers can tune tolerance while investigating. The blackbox reprobe job replays failing prompts across randomized seeds/model-variants and collects a compact reprobe-summary to help triage flakiness. Key behaviors: - Integrates into existing eval-harness CI pipeline as hooks/ci/faithfulness_linter.py and hooks/ci/blackbox_reprobe.py - Default configuration is conservative (warning at 0.75, soft-fail at 0.6, hard-fail at 0.45) and can be overridden per-prompt-set in examples/prompt_sets/*.yaml - Adds a backfill utility (scripts/faithfulness_backfill.py) to recompute faithfulness for historical prompt snapshots and emit an archival CSV for audit - Emits structured diagnostics (prompt id, faithfulness_score, contributing signals) that are archived to artifacts for triage - Adds unit tests and a small smoke prompt-set to tests/ to validate end-to-end behavior Checklist: - [x] Core scorer and metric integration (metrics/faithfulness_metrics.py) - [x] CI hook that gates PRs and posts summary artifact (hooks/ci/faithfulness_linter.py) - [x] Blackbox reprobe runner and artifact uploader (hooks/ci/blackbox_reprobe.py, scripts/reprobe_blackbox.sh) - [x] Tests (tests/test_faithfulness_lint.py, tests/test_reprobe.sh) - [x] Docs update (docs/ci-hooks.md) How to test locally: 1) python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate 2) pip install -r requirements-dev.txt 3) python hooks/ci/faithfulness_linter.py --prompt-set examples/prompt_sets/smoke_faithfulness.yaml --output out.json 4) ./hooks/ci/blackbox_reprobe.py --input out.json --retries 5 A note on thresholds: this PR intentionally uses a multi-stage soft-fail strategy. Early adopters can set 'mode: warn' to avoid failing CI while we tune thresholds. Backfill: run scripts/faithfulness_backfill.py --since 2024-01-01 to generate a historical snapshot. Related: ENG-8123 for rollout plan, SUP-4421 incident follow-up. Motivation and approach documented in docs/ci-hooks.md.

Introduce adaptive faithfulness linter and blackbox reprobe CI hook

Adds a faithfulness metric, CI hook for progressive gating, blackbox reprobe runner, and backfill utility. (ENG-8123)
merge_outcome_summary: Merged after two rounds of fixes: added artifact upload retry and unit test for entailment failure; CI green on final run. No release blocking changes.
